# Stroop

> Stroop is a free online Stroop effect test played as a horror game, at https://stroop.lianhonglim.my. A colour word such as RED appears in a different ink, and the player must name the ink, not the word, while a voice reads the word aloud to throw them off. It runs in any modern browser on computers and phones, with no download or account needed.

Key facts:

- Free, no ads, no download. Playing as a guest needs no account; progress is saved in the browser.
- Modes: Easy (3 colours, 10 words, 6 seconds each, pass 7/10), Normal (6 colours, 20 words, 3 seconds each, pass 15/20), Hard (9 colours, 20 words, 3 seconds each, pass 20/20). Each mode unlocks the next. There is a hidden mode after Hard.
- Controls: click or tap the answer, or press keys 1 to 9; Esc quits a run.
- Optional Google sign-in puts scores on a leaderboard showing the top five per mode. Ranked runs are checked by the server.
- It is a game based on the Stroop effect (J. Ridley Stroop, 1935), not a medical or psychological assessment.
